_comment: The ONLY environment-specific file in this skill. Fill in local paths after installing the plugin in an approved environment. Do not commit live client, borrower, transaction, ticker, vendor, user-profile, or machine-specific paths. Every __SET_...__ value is a placeholder; a read-only review can leave all but the three model_skeleton/corpus_root keys unset (see INSTALL.md step 2).

process_docs._comment: Optional pointers to the desk's own process documents. The canonical process shipped with this toolkit is assets/srt/references/process.md; these entries are only for cross-reference on a machine that holds the desk's Word/PDF versions.

model_skeleton._note: Srt dcf.xlsm is the valuation source of truth. The Gaussian copula is report-only (correlation exhibit) and excluded from the model-update pilot. cln.xlsx holds the Performance Curves tab (registry aggregation target); write inputs-only into a COPY, preserve formulas (scripts/srt-registry-inputs/aggregate_to_cln.py).

run_io._comment: Per-run working locations. {DEAL} and {PERIOD} are filled at run intake. Use redacted/non-client test data unless permissions for the specific run are confirmed.

reference_examples._comment: Optional local visual examples of trustee or investor report layouts. Do not submit real client examples or machine-specific paths. Bundled sandbox scenarios are synthetic and safe to use for tests.

_host_note: Submission-safe template. A local operator edits only this file after install; workbook-bound tests skip loudly until the configured paths resolve.
